benefit: The legume fixes nitrogen and breaks the cereal foliar disease cycle.

Different rooting depth and residue chemistry reduce carryover of cereal pathogens.
A winter cereal between cotton crops lowers verticillium inoculum build-up.
Nitrogen credit from the legume cuts the following maize fertiliser requirement.
Breaking the continuous cereal sequence suppresses sunn pest carryover in stubble.
